source: Seat capture at 2026-10-13T09:33Z of the lane launcher per-run receipts (run log, native-terminal.json, usage.json) and each lane's own final stdout line of the form LANE: STATUS sha. Host labels in the rows are ubuntu0, ubuntu1, ubuntu2, and ubuntu3 as recorded by the launcher. This file is an SNI-local draft contract that consumes those owner-supplied receipt values.

rung_rules.highest_ladder_rung: QUEUED if reserved_at is present, else ACK
rung_rules.note: Launcher refused or failed before the remote CLI started. The lane never started. START and every later rung stay unclaimed even if launched_at or native_started is present.

rung_rules.when: launched_at is present and native_started is true
rung_rules.note: This is a floor, not a skip to DELIVERED. Rule never_started still wins for rc 75/76.

rung_rules.when: rc is empty and done_at is empty
rung_rules.note: Capture ended with no DONE event. This is never DELIVERED.

rung_rules.when: rc is 0 and output_complete is true and a parseable final line is present (lane, status, lane_head)
rc is 0 and no parseable final line is present

rung_rules.note: The rung stays DELIVERED. Integration into an unmerged PR is not CI, MERGED, PRODUCTION_PROOF, or ACCEPTANCE.

bounds: Lanes launched by other seats are not covered.
Launcher receipts captured at 2026-10-13T09:33Z are the only source.
Rows past DELIVERED need the PR merge receipts, which come later.
INT1 PR 9120 was open with CI running at capture and was not merged.
INT1 cherry-pick shas will not exist on main after a squash merge.
A lane_claim of PASS or PARTIAL is the lane's own printed claim, not program closeout.
No row in this ledger is at CI, MERGED, PRODUCTION_PROOF, or ACCEPTANCE.
This draft consumes owner-supplied receipt values. It does not mint issuer or security identifiers.
This module does not feed a ranker, gate, sizer, escalation, or trade path.
